sentence: This project tries to find genetic variants that reduce the effects of risk variants and cigarette smoking on chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
This project studies how phase separation controls the enzymatic activity of a core complex that regulates histone methylation and is often disrupted in acute leukemias.
This project studies how viruses and their hosts interact, to develop strategies that prevent and limit viral diseases.
This project provides pathology services that support cancer studies of animal and human specimens, including digital pathology and single cell analysis of the tumor microenvironment.
This project builds tools that let mass spectrometry read large RNAs carrying covalent modifications, using RNA-cleaving deoxyribozymes and capillary electrophoresis.
This project reads whole genome sequences from people of African and European ancestry and links them to clinical and neuropathologic traits of dementia.
This project uses machine learning to sort autism into subtypes and severity scores and to find genetic and prenatal environmental risk factors for them.
This project tries to develop inhibitors that selectively block one enzyme and only moderately trap it, reducing dose-limiting side effects.
This project uses large collections of real-world data to study how Alzheimer's disease risk and progression differ in sexual and gender minority populations.
This project builds a fast multiphoton microscope that images immune cells in human skin without labels, including during wound healing.
This project tries to find genes that raise the risk of heart attack in heart disease patients but not of heart disease itself.
This project studies whether mutational signatures found in civilian tumors also appear in tumors from Veterans and whether they predict treatment response.
This project develops therapies for acute leukemia that take advantage of disrupted sphingolipid metabolism in the disease.
This project studies how overactive transposable elements affect individual brain cells in people with and without Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds and tests an artificial intelligence system that automatically interprets echocardiography and writes reports on it.
This project develops methods that measure how uncertain predictions about a patient are, so mobile health support can make better decisions.
This project studies how the immune system can be used to prevent and treat cancer, and how immune responses against tumors are regulated.
This project develops analysis methods for basket, hybrid controlled and platform trials that test cancer treatments in rare cancers and elderly patients.
This project explores gene therapy as a treatment for a disease that causes sudden cardiac death in young individuals.
This project studies how people affected by the attacks manage their emotions, and how this relates to post-traumatic stress and prolonged grief.
